contexts.text: The exteriors with Him were human from Mary His mother.
Hence He was no longer the son of Mary. AC 4692:5. AC 6872:end. AC 10057:end. AC 10830. NJHD 295.

Mary the Lord's mother once passed by, and was seen (in Heaven) above the head in white clothing (as of silk); and then she stayed a little and said that she had been the mother of the Lord, and indeed that He was born from her; but that having become God, He had put off the human from her; and that therefore she now adores Him as her God; and that she is unwilling for anyone to acknowledge Him as her son, because in Him everything is Divine. TCR 102:3. TCR 827. SE 5834. SE 5992. DeDomino 31. LJPost 69.
In other places, Mary is called His mother; but not from His mouth.
You call Mary the mother of God; consequently you acknowledge that she bore God; that is, the Divine Human...
A monk... said that he could think of the Divine Human in relation to the most holy virgin Mary, the god-bearer. TCR 111:12.
By these words is meant, that the Lord did not acknowledge Mary as His mother; but the Church; and therefore He called her Woman, and the mother of the disciple.
In the same proportion (a Christian polygamist) at heart acknowledges the Lord... as the son of Mary, and not at the same time as the Son of God.
This has been effected through the Human which He assumed through the virgin Mary...

He is called the Son of God, the Son of Man, and the Son of Mary; and by... the Son of Mary is properly meant the Human which He assumed... That by the Sou of Mary is meant what is merely human, is manifestly evident from the generation of men, in that the soul is from the father, and the body from the mother...

In modern Christian Churches it is a general thing to call our Lord the Saviour the Son of Mary, and rarely the Son of God, unless they then understand the Son of God born from eternity. The source of this is that the Roman Catholics have sanctified Mary above the rest, and have set her over all their saints as a goddess or queen; when yet the Lord, when He had glorified His Human, put off everything of His mother, and put on everything of the Father... From this general thing in the mouth of all, that He is called the Son of Mary, many enormities have inflowed into the Church... (which) are, that the idea of Divinity in relation to the Lord perishes, and, with this, all that which has been said in the Word concerning Him as the Son of God; then, that through this there enter Judaism, Arianism, Socinianism, Calvinism such as this was in the beginning; and, at last, naturalism; and, with this, the frantic madness that He was the son of Mary by Joseph; and also that He had His soul from the mother... Let everyone, both clergyman and layman, consider with himself as to whether he has conceived and cherishes any other idea about the Lord, as the son of Mary, than as of a mere man.
These things take place while a man regards the Lord God the Redeemer and Saviour as the mere son of Mary; thus as a mere man.

It is believed that the Lord as to the Human not only has been, but also is, the son of Mary; but in this the Christian world hallucinates. That He has been the son of Mary is true; but that He is so still is not true; for by the acts of Redemption He put off the human from the mother, and put on the Human from the Father... (as) may be seen from this: that He Himself has never called Mary His mother. Illustrated... Thus did the Lord not call her mother, but woman; and He gave her to John as a mother. In other places she is called His mother; but not from His own mouth.
He who does not believe this; but only that He is the son of Mary; implants in himself various ideas about Him which are hurtful and destructive of his salvation.
Hence it is that He was not the son of David, as neither was He the son of Mary...
The leaping in the womb at the salutation of Mary, represented joy from the love of the conjunction of good and truth...
By the woman () the Papists understand Mary and the worship of her...
With those who are of Babylon, (the Word) is acknowledged as Divine on account of... the historicals about Mary, etc.
That which was born from Mary, the Lord... expelled.
The Virgin Mary was seen...
Redeemer. 2. Jehovah God... assumed the Human in the Virgin Mary.
Redeemer. 4. The Holy Spirit who came upon Mary = the Divine truth; and the Power of the Highest which overshadowed her = the Divine good...
Redeemer. 9. 6. Christ, through this human... from [being] the son of Mary, made Himself the Son of God.
Redeemer. 9. 8. But Mary His mother afterwards represented the Church; and in this respect she is to be named His mother.
